views.markdown: **AntiDarkSword** protects your device from hidden web browser exploits and silent iMessage attacks (like Coruna, DarkSword, and BLASTPASS).

• **Browser Protection** — Makes web browsing safer by reducing areas attackers can target.

• **iMessage Security** — Blocks silent attacks by stopping dangerous file downloads and risky attachment previews (like PDFs and images).

• **Content Blocking** — Automatically blocks unsafe content in messaging and mail apps.

• **Device Cloaking** — Spoofs environments that are not vulnerable causing most payloads to abort.

• **Decoy System** — Tricks attackers into thinking your device is a test virtual machine, stopping many advanced attacks in their tracks.

• **Background Service Protection** — Secures core system services (like message syncing) when using higher security levels.

• **Level 1** — Web browsers, mail, messaging, and web-heavy apps.

• **Level 2** — Everything in Level 1, plus social media and entertainment apps.

• **Level 3** — Everything in Level 2, plus background system services.

*Note: You can easily set custom rules to override these levels for specific apps if you need to.*
